visual_brief.subject: Coding agents write reusable planners for simulated robot tasks
verified_context: Coding agents explore simulators and write programs within a fixed budget, then frozen programs solve unseen simulated robot tasks without an LLM at test time.
The study uses fully observed simulated object states and does not establish real-robot performance under uncertain perception.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A reusable physical guide can carry a planning strategy after its creation; show no robot or literal tested control architecture.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A curved terracotta guide passes around pale stone obstacles as a reusable route template, a physical abstract metaphor rather than a chart or actual robot path.
must_show: central focal forms that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable sculptural route around three obstacles; the tall rear obstacle creates a more crowded desktop crop.
candidate_notes.B: Viable low-perspective guide; foreground ribbon and large obstacles reduce negative space and crop flexibility.
candidate_notes.C: Selected: a single thick reusable curve and two obstacles retain a clear silhouette with generous paper space; no robot or literal control architecture.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 514 centered 21:9 crop inspected. Desktop crop trims a far end of the curve, preserving the relationship around both obstacles. Square crop cuts part of the right obstacle and route ends; the central guide-around-obstacles idea survives.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 202 centered 16:9 crop inspected; focal forms remain visible.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 centered cover crop inspected; focal silhouette remains distinct.
crop_review.home_square: 260 x 260 centered square preview inspected; nonessential edges crop as noted above.

golden_reference_comparison: The stone obstacles, warm field, terracotta curve and fine supporting construction lines share the reference material language. It is deliberately simpler than the references and carries the reusable-planning idea through physical form rather than an invented technical diagram.
contact_sheet_renderer: Pillow fallback with two golden references above three candidates. Canonical contact-sheet CLI was attempted and could not launch the missing Playwright Chromium. The official browser download had already failed with a truncated/non-ZIP payload during the previous batch; it was not retried. No repository code or validator was changed.

generation_metadata.review_type: Codex model visual self-review; no human sign-off
